title: docs(changeset): four pending bodies cite the retire-vs-remove discriminator instead of restating it
body:
Fixes #9932

Four pending `.changeset/*.md` bodies stated this package's retire-vs-remove discriminator in its **un-amended two-prong form**. A pending body publishes **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, and the release window is open, so each was about to teach every upgrading reader the rule in the spelling objectui#7678's amendment exists to deny.

Each definition sentence is now a **citation** of objectui#7678 and restates no definition, per the route the triage seat pre-authorised on the card. **Frontmatter is untouched in all four**, and every reasoning sentence beside the definitions is kept verbatim: neither retirement is in question and no conclusion was wrong.

## Stop condition, checked first and again before the push

PR objectui#5400 「chore: release packages」 — `open`, **not draft**, **not merged**. The card's re-shaping trigger has not fired, so the card keeps its shape and its `p1`.

Stronger than the card knew: **all four files are in objectui#5400's own removal set.** Paging that PR's complete file list gives 1732 rows, 1651 `removed` (all `.changeset/*.md`) and 81 `modified` (package `CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json`). Every one of the four bodies below is a `removed` row in it — they are consumed by that release, and their prose is what lands in the CHANGELOG when it merges.

## What each file needed, measured on this branch's base `6c06f0b50`

| file | what it published | what it publishes now |
|---|---|---|
| `5942-retire-mobile-component-config.md` | the definition, un-amended | a citation of objectui#7678 |
| `7519-retire-mobile-residue-types.md` | the definition, un-amended, named 「two-prong」 | a citation of objectui#7678; the per-prong measurement kept as the record |
| `4919-retire-mobile-overrides.md` | the definition, un-amended — **a fourth instance the card did not name** | a citation of objectui#7678 |
| `7703-chatbot-dark-keys-retired.md` | an accurate quotation whose rule-provenance rode on a file path | provenance on the cards; the quotation keeps its `mobile.ts` attribution |

### Phrase probes, base against this branch

Run with `git grep -c`, whole tree:

| probe | at base | on this branch |
|---|---|---|
| `steers authors to a named` in `.changeset/` | `5942` 1 · `7519` 1 | **0** |
| `taught as working` in `.changeset/` | `4919` 1 · `5942` 1 · `7519` 1 · `7678` 1 | **`7678` 1 only** — the authority, which must keep it |
| `two-prong` in `.changeset/` | `7519` 1 · `7703` 1 | **0** |
| `objectui#7678` in the four files | 0 | **1 each** |

**LIT CONTROL:** the same probes still return `packages/types/src/complex.ts` 2 and `packages/types/src/mobile.ts` 1 for `steers authors to a named`, so the zeros above are readings and not a blind instrument. Those remaining sites are the **source-tree JSDoc** population, which is objectui#9930's — untouched here, per this card's fence.

## Two corrections this branch measured

### 1. The `7703` pointer is **not** stale on `main` — so it was not rewritten as if it were

The card's third-instance comment measured `mobile.ts` on PR objectui#9926's head and concluded `mobile.ts` no longer defines the rule. Re-measured on this base:

- `steers authors to a named` on `packages/types/src/mobile.ts` → **1** (still defines it)
- `surviving carrier` on `packages/types/src/mobile.ts` → **0** case-sensitive, but **2** case-**insensitive**: that file spells the amended clause `SURVIVING CARRIER` in upper case.

So on `main` today `mobile.ts` states the discriminator **in its amended form**, and the `7703` parenthetical resolves. The case-sensitive zero was an instrument artifact at this base.

**It is a true zero at objectui#9926's head**, checked both ways on head `2f082847f`: `surviving carrier` → 0 case-sensitive **and** 0 case-insensitive, `steers authors to a named` → 0. That PR is still an open draft, so the pointer goes stale only if it lands.

⇒ `7703` was therefore **not** rewritten to describe a state that does not exist. Only the rule's provenance moves off the file path and onto the cards — the shape that is correct both before and after objectui#9926 lands. The quotation keeps its `mobile.ts` attribution, which is measured durable: `no silent-strip hazard` → 2 on `mobile.ts` at this base **and** 2 at objectui#9926's head.

### 2. A fourth instance, and why it is repaired here rather than carded

A declared census of the pending set found `.changeset/4919-retire-mobile-overrides.md` carrying the same un-amended definition.

- **Population:** 1746 pending `.changeset/*.md` on this base.
- **Probes:** `replacement key` (prong 1 wording) → 7 files; `taught as working` (prong 2 wording) → 4 files. Only files hit by **both** state the rule: `4919`, `5942`, `7519`. The other four `replacement key` hits (`8754`, `8800`, `8801`, `9040`) use the phrase to say a retired key **has** no replacement — not definitions, and correctly left alone.
- **LIT CONTROL:** `tombstone` over the same population → 110 files, so the census reaches the corpus and the narrow hits are not an empty read.

It is repaired in place rather than carded because all four conditions for a bounded in-place fix hold: same defect class, mechanical shape already fixed by the route, no other claim on the file (screened below), and the same gate family with no new verification surface. The decisive one is the fifth fact: **it sits in the same irreversible release window.** Carding it means racing objectui#5400 a second time for a one-sentence fix in the same directory under the same gates.

This is a declared increment over the three-file surface the claim comment listed.

## One piece of the route declined, with the measurement for it

The route offered a text anchor at `.changeset/7678-tombstone-discriminator-agreement.md` alongside the card. **That path is itself a `removed` row in objectui#5400.** Citing it from a body that publishes in the same release would put a pointer in the CHANGELOG to a file that release deletes — a fresh instance of exactly the provenance defect `7703` was filed for. The four bodies therefore cite the **card** objectui#7678 only, which is durable.

## Verification

Every gate named on the card, each exit captured before any pipe:

| gate | exit | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | **0** | 「4 file(s) changed, 0 of them published source of a package the release covers … no changeset is owed」 |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | **0** | 「No pending changeset names a file this change touches.」 — **report-only**, no enforcing mode |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | **0** | 「No changeset declares a `major` bump.」 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` | **0** | **report-only**; reports the 4 modified bodies as its own case 2, 「You are CORRECTING a declaration on purpose — … prose that no longer matches the change. Legitimate」 |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | **0** | 「No test source names a pending changeset.」 |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | **0** | 「OK (scanned 8031 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)」 |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | **0** | 「0 new citation(s), enforcement **report-only**」 |

`check-changeset-overwrite` also prints the frontmatter proof directly: for each of the four, 「declared at base」 and 「declares now」 are **identical**.

**Governed-surface guard over the FINAL file list**, verdict verbatim:

```
node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test .changeset/4919-retire-mobile-overrides.md .changeset/5942-retire-mobile-component-config.md .changeset/7519-retire-mobile-residue-types.md .changeset/7703-chatbot-dark-keys-retired.md
✅ NOT GOVERNED — 4 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched.
   An ordinary pull request: the normal review and merge-queue route applies.
```

**Tests.** The diff touches zero package source, so no package's suite is affected: `git grep` over `*.ts`, `*.tsx`, `*.mjs` finds **zero** sources naming any of the four files and **zero** quoting any removed phrase. The five gate suites that read `.changeset/` were run anyway, under the shared heavy-verify lock:

```
pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-changeset-{claims,overwrite,presence,no-major}.test.ts scripts/__tests__/check-pending-changeset-literals.test.ts
Test Files  5 passed (5)
     Tests  207 passed (207)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```

**Self-scan for control bytes** over the four files, beyond the gate: `grep -naP` for the C0 range plus DEL returns no match.

**Hot-file screen, re-run on the final list.** All 13 open PRs re-listed and their file lists re-read: **zero** overlap with any non-release PR. LIT CONTROL: that same screen returns 17 `.changeset/` rows, so it reaches the directory. The only open PR holding these files is objectui#5400 itself, which is the window this card exists to beat and which the triage seat explicitly declined to touch.

## Acceptance notes

- **Stopping at draft, deliberately.** The guard above says NOT GOVERNED, which under AGENTS.md's green-PR clause would let the author self-merge. This dispatch says stop at draft. That conflict is filed as objectstack#19128 and unruled, so this branch takes the stricter side: **no ready flip, no auto-merge, no CI wait.** The seat lands it.
- **No label applied**, which is the settled answer here: this repo names no dev-applied label and forbids `skip-changeset`, and `needs:contract-review` is the seat's to mount.
- **The census gap the card marks NOT MEASURED is narrowed, not closed.** The probes above are phrase probes over 1746 bodies. A body that states the rule in wording sharing neither phrase is outside their reach, and that residual is unmeasured.
- *noted, not filed:* `packages/types/src/mobile.ts` states the rule at four sites and `complex.ts` at three, one of which annotates itself as 「under correction as objectui#7678」. That is the source-tree population, already owned by objectui#9930 (`needs-user-decision`) and being moved by PR objectui#9926 — not widened into here. Successor: objectui#9930.
- *noted, not filed:* the claim comment declares no `Clause-②` line to copy, and nothing in this repo reads one — `git grep` finds the token in a single script header and in no workflow or gate. `Check Changeset` here is `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, which reads the diff and not the PR body, and it exits 0 with 「no changeset is owed」. Successor: none.
